Findings so far

Which side of AI each year's companies sit on

Judged on each company's current product. Companies competing head-on with general models fell from 32% of the 2021 batches to 1% of 2026, while products built on top of models went from 14% to over half. Older years are partly survivors that rebranded around AI.

Inactive rate by AI side (2022-2023)

Current productnInactive
Competes with models15121%
Built on models46111%
Sells to AI builders6512%
Outside AI43812%

Companies competing with models died at about twice the rate of the rest (odds ratio 2.0, p = 0.004). Labels were set without seeing status. Part of the gap is adaptation: companies that pivoted onto AI now count as "Built on models".

ZIRP bet: hindsight vs. blind labels

Idea depended on 2020-21?2021, status visibleW22, status hidden
Yes51% (108)18% (38)
Partly19% (171)25% (20)
No8% (375)11% (340)

With status hidden, the gap between "yes" and "no" shrinks from 43 points to 7 (p = 0.29). Most of the 2021 effect was hindsight in the labeling.

Appendix: data and method

Every company in YC's public directory from Winter 2021 through Fall 2026, 3,793 in all, labeled for AI exposure. The 2021 batches also carry ZIRP and pivot labels, and W22 carries a status-blind ZIRP label. Status, team size and location are as YC currently reports them. Click a column header to sort.

Source: YC company directory via the open yc-oss mirror (yc-oss.github.io/api), pulled Oct 5, 2026. "Top" marks companies YC flags as top companies. Crowd counts batch-mates whose current YC descriptions are similar (TF-IDF cosine 0.2 or higher); hover a number to see the closest matches. All labels were set by Claude. 2021 batches: 50 pilot companies checked against 2021 Wayback snapshots and live homepages; the rest from 2021 Hacker News launch posts (H), Wayback snapshots (A), and YC former names plus Claude's knowledge (K), with company status visible. 2022-2026 batches (source D): labeled from YC descriptions with company status hidden. A ? means there was not enough to go on. AI labels describe the current product and reflect models as of October 2026. Team size is self-reported on YC's profile and can be stale.

Team / yr is current team size divided by years since the batch started. It is a rough growth proxy, and team sizes on YC profiles can be stale. Lenses are simple rules over these columns.
